name: Plinth
desc: Stands at the front and takes the hits. Plinths start fights, pin enemies in place and keep allies behind them safe.
shape: Block: widest at the shoulders (at least 1.4 times the hips), flat crown, square stance.

name: Breaker
desc: Fights up close and stays standing. Breakers trade blow for blow, crack the front line and wear down anyone who lingers near them.
shape: Inverted wedge: heavy shoulders narrowing to the feet, one oversized weapon carried on one side.

name: Striker
desc: Picks one target and ends it quickly. Strikers slip past the front line, hit hard in a short window and get out again.
shape: Forward diagonal: narrow body leaning 10 to 15 degrees into the run, asymmetric points.

name: Slinger
desc: Deals steady damage from range. Slingers grow strongest late and need space and cover to keep firing.
shape: Horizontal: a long weapon held across the body (bow, sling, spear-thrower; never a firearm).

name: Caster
desc: Shapes the fight with abilities. Casters land bursts, lay down zones and lock enemies in place from a distance.
shape: Line plus disc: a tall vertical body topped by a headpiece, hood or halo.

name: Tender
desc: Keeps allies alive and the fight in their favour. Tenders heal, shield, speed up and spot for the team.
shape: Round and open, carrying a light vessel (a lamp, bell or glass) at the chest or in hand.
